events.title: VOIDHOLD is in Steam Next Fest — play the free demo
events.summary: VOIDHOLD is part of Steam Next Fest from 19 to 26 October, and the free demo is ready for Windows and Linux. What's in the demo Three campaign worlds — Ruins, Dusk and Canopy — and 30 levels. All six weapons, the Field Armory and the first two PROGRAMS. Two OPERATIONS: GLASS STORM in Glacier, then JUGGERNAUTS in the Wastes once you earn Bronze. Your progress carries into the full game. New since the demo launched A third campaign world and the two operations. The whole game in twelve languages.

events.title: The VOIDHOLD demo is out — free on Steam
events.summary: The VOIDHOLD demo is out. Three campaign worlds — Ruins, Dusk and Canopy — and 30 levels, plus the GLASS STORM and JUGGERNAUTS operations. All six weapons, the first two PROGRAMS and twelve languages. Free, Windows and Linux, full controller support. Download the demo from the store page. Your progress carries over. Demo and full game share one Steam Cloud save: SALVAGE, PROGRAMS and your saved run continue after purchase. No achievements or online boards in the demo — Steam keeps those per app,

events.title: Feedback channels are open
events.summary: VOIDHOLD is heading for Early Access on 5 November 2026. Two threads are now pinned in the Discussions, and they are the fastest way to reach me: 💡 SUGGESTIONS — balance, quality of life, controls, anything you would change. Tell me what you expected instead; the expectation is usually the real signal. 🐛 BUG REPORTS — one report per post. Freezes and crashes jump the queue.
